name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking. Optional Telegram reports and commands, and automatic categorization of Amazon charges from their order emails.

release.notes: Transaction rules can now mark a payback as a reimbursement. A rule sets an activity's subtype as well as its type, so a Venmo or Zelle repayment imports as a credit marked REIMBURSEMENT and reduces whatever category you file it under instead of counting as income — and the next sync applies it to transactions already imported, so a recurring payback is fixed once rather than one at a time. The Telegram bot's /recategorize now refuses a move Wealthfolio would reject, and says what would make it work, instead of clearing the old category and failing afterwards. Also fixes a sync that could import transactions and fail to send the Telegram notice without recording why.
